findings.claim: The comment ends with a bare reference "(L71)" that has no stated meaning inside the file. A reader cannot tell whether it points to a line, a log entry or a requirement, and a line number in a comment goes stale as the file changes. Name the check or the log entry instead.

evidence: The only changed file is a test; the diff adds t.Fatalf/t.Fatal guards on the frontmatterBlock ok result and on the Store.Get tracked result, which can only make the setup stricter and cannot hide a failure.
The guards use the same variable names (ok, tracked) as the values that were previously discarded; the diff shows no shadowing or unused variables.
The rewritten comment states a scratch-edit observation that cannot be verified from the diff, and it ends with the unexplained reference (L71).
